REPLACEABLE GRAPHICS

brand-logo.svg
Replace with your bus company logo. Keep the same filename to avoid changing code. SVG is preferred; to use PNG/WebP, update its path in the application's branding configuration.

ticket-watermark.svg
A neutral bus emblem for the ticket background. Replace with a pale version of your company seal or another transparent graphic.

qr-ticket.svg
A real, scannable QR containing DEMO ticket data. It is a design-preview asset, not a valid travel ticket. Replace this graphic with a QR produced by your own booking service when connecting the app to real bookings. It uses a four-module white quiet zone; preserve that border so the QR remains readable. The static asset does not automatically change when preview fields are edited.

home-*.svg
Reference-derived artwork for the Home cards and social banner, isolated as replaceable assets. Set BRAND.homeAssets to use your own bus company artwork.

Operator logos and installation icons are neutral placeholders. Montserrat and its license are included in fonts/.
